whisperbrowser.title: Whisper listening in the browser
whisperbrowser.intro: Speech recognition on the device, in the browser. The model downloads once; what you say never leaves the device.
whisperbrowser.model.hint: A speech recognition model in ONNX for transformers.js. Empty: the best one for each language.
whisperbrowser.wait.hint: Off: until the model has downloaded, the fallback listener hears you. On: it waits, for a device with no network to fall back on.
